title: Legacy Rate Type Values
description: Legacy per_-prefixed rate tokens. Permanently accepted on the request path because shared short URLs carry them; normalize_output_param translates each to the canonical output param before anything reads it. Canonical source is libs-shared/data-views-output-tokens.mjs. New views should declare output directly -- see ../schemas/output-parameter.json and ./output-periods.json.

translation.description: Each token maps to (period, aggregation: 'rate') by stripping the per_ prefix. There is no legacy token for the count aggregation -- it is new capability with no rate_type equivalent.

week_axis.reason: The per-game denominator is always 1 at week grain, so normalize_output_param drops the output param silently under a week row axis.

row_axis_compatibility.note: Every other token is compatible with the year and week row axes. Compatibility is a property of the resolved (period, aggregation) tuple, not of the legacy token -- see ../../validation/parameter-compatibility.json.
